title: What If the Sun Got Just 10 Percent Brighter?

scenes.text: What if the Sun got only ten percent brighter? That would end Earth's oceans.
It's already happening, slowly. The Sun gains about one percent brightness every 110 million years.
Ten percent is the tipping point. The air would hold far more water vapor.
Water vapor traps heat, which evaporates more water. A runaway loop.
Models say the oceans could boil dry, in roughly a billion years.
Long before the Sun swells into a red giant, Earth is already a dead world.
